FACTUAL POSITION & PLEADINGS 1.

Vide this judgment/award, this Tribunal shall decide petition/application/DAR filed for compensation on account of death of Praveen Thankachan in a road vehicular accident which took place on 21.11.2017 at about 04:00 am at Faridabad - Gurugram Road, Near Liquor Shop within the jurisdiction of PS Suraj Kund, Faridabad, Haryana.
CASE OF THE PETITIONER SIDE 2.1

Succinctly, the case put forward by petition/application/DAR is that on 21.11.2017, Praveen Thankachan (since deceased) was coming to Gurugram from Faridabad along-with his friend Sh. Jothish Thomas and one Gugan Ram on car make Maruti Wagon-R bearing registration number DL-9CL-2790.

Sh. Jothish Thomas was driving the car,
Praveen Thankchan (deceased) was sitting at front left seat and Gugan Ram was sitting at rear seat.
Sh. Jothish Thomas was driving his car carefully and at moderate speed.

At about 04:00 am, when they reached at T-Point of Faridabad - Mehrauli Road, all of a sudden, a pick-up van bearing registration number RJ- 32GB-4659 being driven by its driver in rash and negligent manner came in high speed from front side and hit their car with great force.
As a consequence, they all received various injuries.

The injured Jothish Thomas in his statement recorded by R3W2 on 26.11.2017 (part of Ex.PW1/3) has stated the number of offending vehicle as RJ-32GB-4659.

The R3W4 SI Satbir Singh who was 2nd IO after R3W2 has deposed that when the investigation of the case was handed over to him, the name and address of accused driver and registration number of offending vehicle were not available.
He traced the offending vehicle from number plate which was found at the place of incident.
He deposed that the injured Jothish Thomas never informed him about the registration number of offending vehicle.

He arrested the respondent no.01/driver of offending vehicle, seized the offending vehicle bearing registration number RJ-32GB-4659 and also got it mechanically inspected vide Ex.R3W4/2 from Motor Mechanic ASI Ravinder on 19.12.2017.
It is clear from the copy of charge-sheet submitted on record that offending vehicle was mentioned as unknown vehicle in statement of R3W1 upon which FIR was registered.
There is no mention of any number plate or any front bumper of offending vehicle being found at the place of incident on the date of incident.

There is no mention of any number plate or any front bumper of offending vehicle being found at the place of incident on the date of incident.

He has not even found any fresh repair work being done on said vehicle in his inspection.
The said vehicle was planted by the investigating agency as offending vehicle in connivance with claimant(s)/LRs of the deceased persons, respondent no.01 and 02 and other unknown persons involved so that the claimant(s) can get hefty claim since otherwise he/she/they would have been entitled only for claim as a case of hit and run.
